top6_grace.length_note: Grace spell length is the full span, first season to last inclusive, so a one-season dip inside the spell counts toward its length (and toward length_distribution, persistent_contenders and the 13-season cap). in_window_seasons on each spell counts only the seasons actually in the window; those sum to in_window_club_seasons.

patterns.definition: Readings at threshold k: Opening Day od_rank, deadline pd_rank, and the same club's od_rank the following season; above means rank <= k. 2026 rows get partial labels and are excluded from 2014-2025 counts.

sequences.note: Clubs with labels from the set in two or more consecutive seasons, 2014-2025 (2026 partial labels excluded). Null: labels shuffled across clubs within each season, 10000 times, seed 20261024; p95 uses linear interpolation.

backcast.source: Baseball-Reference preseason playoff odds (earliest row per club-season)

hazard.definition: window_top6, strict consecutive spells. One row per spell per season n, 2014-2025 (2026 excluded: 2027 not observed). event = 1 if out of the window at season n+1's Opening Day. era12 = 1 if n+1 >= 2022. strength = 162 x (Opening Day proj_w/(proj_w+proj_l) minus that of the league's od_rank-7 club), season n. od_log2_rel from payroll.csv, season n. pd_above = pd_rank <= 6 in season n.

samples.F: Left-censored spells dropped; duration = duration_obs. Primary.
samples.L: All spells; left-censored spells enter in 2014 at duration 1.
samples.H: All spells; left-censored spells enter in 2014 at the top bin (4+) and stay there: bin 4+, ln(duration capped at 4) = ln 4, duration-1 indicator 0. In the exact-duration life table they enter at duration 4 and count up (duration_obs + 3); 'entered' counts these delayed entries.

M1.ci_note: Hazard = logistic(bin coefficient), no intercept. ci95_model uses the ordinary ML standard error; ci95_cluster clusters by team_id. Both are Wald intervals on the logit scale, transformed.

hazard.model_notes: Discrete-time logit. M2/M2b: standard errors clustered by team_id (statsmodels cluster, default small-sample correction G/(G-1) x (N-1)/(N-K)); intervals are Wald, normal reference. LR test uses the ordinary likelihood: M1 (4 bin parameters) vs. intercept + ln(duration capped at 4), df 2.

closing_by_strength_band.definition: Club-seasons by Opening Day strength in season n (wins per 162 above the league's od_rank-7 club); closings = event (out of the window at n+1's Opening Day); share = closings / club-seasons.

forecasts_2027.definition: P(window_top6 window open on 2026 Opening Day is closed on 2027 Opening Day), M2 in sample F as estimated (hazard.models.F.M2), 2026 Opening Day inputs, era12 = 1. ci95: Wald interval on the logit scale with the club-clustered covariance, both ends transformed. Text: docs/forecasts-2027.md.

od_underdogs.description: Opening Day underdogs: realized qualifiers vs. sum of OD odds, with a 5th-95th percentile range from independent-Bernoulli simulation. Descriptive; does not test P2.
od_underdogs.seeding: numpy default_rng([seed, variant index, season(, league index)])
od_underdogs.note_2020: 16-team field; OD odds are Win Div 1st + Win Div 2nd + Clinch Wild Card

outside_berths.definition: outside the top N in the league on Opening Day (N = berths per league)

outside_berths_plus2.definition: outside the top N + 2 in the league on Opening Day (N = berths per league)

hazard_robustness.definition: Post 1 hazard (hazard.py's M1, M2, M2b and bins-vs-log test) under the pre-specified window variants, flow sample F only. Strength = wins per 162 above the first club out at the variant's threshold (reference_rank). Era, payroll and the duration cap (4) as at baseline. Bins fixed at 1, 2, 3, 4+. M2/M2b standard errors clustered by team_id (statsmodels default small-sample correction); intervals Wald, normal reference; p_normal against the normal, p_t against t with G - 1 df (G = clubs in F). Grace: closes after two straight Opening Days out; dip seasons are not rows but count toward duration; closing recorded in the last in-window season; rows through 2024; spells starting 2014-2015 left-censored.

M1.zero_closing_note: Bin(s) 3 had zero closings and were not fitted: hazard_raw = 0 with an exact (Clopper-Pearson) 95% interval. Their rows were left out of the fit; loglik equals the full-data log-likelihood at the limit (hazard 0, contribution 0). Clustered SEs use n_clusters_fitted clubs.

lr_bins_vs_log.zero_closing_note: Zero-closing bin(s) enter the bins model's log-likelihood at the limit (hazard 0, contribution 0); df unchanged at 2.

top6_grace.era12_note: era12 = 1 if n+1 >= 2022, as at baseline. Under grace a closing at n is decided by the Opening Days of n+1 and n+2; rows with n = 2020 have era12 = 0 and n+2 = 2022.

hazard_inference.definition: Small-cluster inference per docs/decisions.md 2026-11-01 item E. t_correction: p_t = 2 x t_{G-1} tail at the clustered z in hazard.models (G = clubs); p_normal is hazard's normal-reference p. score_bootstrap: Kline & Santos (2012) wild score bootstrap for strength in M2, sample F, restricted fit M2 without strength, Webb weights by club, no refitting, H fixed at the restricted estimates; p_bootstrap = share of draws with |T*| >= |T|; p_normal = 2 x normal tail at T; no small-sample scaling. size_check: the same test on datasets simulated under the restricted model.

score_bootstrap.weights: Webb six-point: +/-sqrt(3/2), +/-1, +/-sqrt(1/2), each 1/6; one per club per draw
score_bootstrap.rng: numpy default_rng(SeedSequence(master_seed)); weights drawn as one (draws x clubs) array, clubs in ascending team_id order

size_check.dgp: event ~ Bernoulli(p~), p~ = restricted-model fitted probabilities on the real F rows; same rows, clubs and covariates
size_check.seeding: dataset k uses default_rng(SeedSequence(master_seed).spawn(500)[k]) for its outcomes, then its 999 weight draws

jordan_comparison.definition: Jordan (2018) contending season, end_of_season snapshot, 2014-2025: division winner (division order by W%; ties for first broken by the actual division title, see ties_for_first; ties below first share the better rank); postseason as a non-division-winner (postseason_odds >= 0.999); 2nd or 3rd in the division with games behind the division winner <= 5 (games behind = ((leader W - W) + (L - leader L)) / 2); or W >= 87. 2020: W% >= .537 and <= 1.85 games. Window opens with the first of two straight contending seasons, survives one non-contending season, closes after two straight non-contending seasons and ends at the last contending season before them; length = full span. Left-censored unless two straight non-contending seasons occur in 2014 to the season before the window's first contending season. Right-censored: last contending season 2024 or 2025.

comparison_samples.grace: data/processed/hazard_robustness_pp.csv, variant top6_grace, left_censored = 0 (spells starting 2014 or 2015 excluded).

jordan_comparison.life_table_note: Jordan life table built as the grace variant's: one row per contending season in a window, duration = seasons since the window opened (gap seasons count toward it but are not rows), closing recorded in the last contending season, rows through 2023 (the last season whose outcome, two seasons on, is observed). windows_with_rows excludes windows opening after 2023. Strict and grace life tables are hazard.py's life_table on their person-period rows. survival_after j = product of (1 - hazard) over durations <= j; null where the table ends before j. Strict and grace windows are measured in Opening Day seasons, Jordan windows in end-of-season records.
jordan_comparison.min_length_note: Jordan windows cannot be shorter than 2 seasons.
